pkgmetadata.longdescription: MMM (Monitoring and Maintenance Manager) is NEC's proprietary host-side management agent for SX-Aurora TSUBASA Vector Engine cards. This package installs the vecmd command, used to query card status (vecmd state get) and hardware information (vecmd info), together with the ve_monitor daemon it queries. Card management requires MMM firmware on the VE and a valid MMM license.
